title: Matter note properties
description: The properties of a Matter note in Matters that Matter: an open line of work that needs attention from time to time, shown as one lane on the board. The note's file name is the Matter's name. The Inbox is a Matter too; which note it is comes from the plugin's settings (inboxPath in data.json; see settings.json), not from its properties; don't create a Matter named like the Inbox ("Inbox", "Inbox 2"), which the plugin takes for a copy of it. Only the mtm- properties listed here belong to a Matter; any property without the mtm- prefix is allowed and left alone. This schema describes what a tool should write; Matters that Matter reads more than it allows (older forms and values written by hand) and never rewrites them on its own. Later versions of the plugin may add mtm- properties; the file at this address is updated to list them, and a change that would refuse what was valid before gets a new address (v2).

mtm-kind.description: Marks the note as a Matter. Notes are recognised by this property, never by their folder.

mtm-icon.description: The name of a Lucide icon shown with the Matter, such as house or briefcase. Matters have no colour; the icon and the name identify them. When absent, circle-dot is shown. The Inbox uses inbox.

mtm-state.description: active (the default when absent), dormant (set aside for now) or closed (finished). Dormant and closed Matters start collapsed on the board. The Inbox is always active.

mtm-lane-order.description: The lane's place on the board, lower first. Matters without one come after those with one, by name. A new Matter takes the highest value in use plus one.

mtm-sphere.description: The ID of the Sphere (a sphere of life such as Home or Work) that the Matter belongs to, from the plugin's settings (data.json; see settings.json). Leave it out for no Sphere. An ID that is not in settings counts as no Sphere and shows a badge. Ignored on the Inbox.

mtm-review-every.description: How often the Matter is due for a review: a whole number followed by d (days), w (weeks) or m (calendar months), such as 2w. Leave it out for no reviews. Ignored on the Inbox.

mtm-last-reviewed.description: The day the Matter was last reviewed: a real calendar day, as YYYY-MM-DD. The next review falls due one rhythm (mtm-review-every) later; a Matter with a rhythm and no review yet counts as due.

mtm-outcome.description: One line saying what done looks like, or the standard to keep. Optional; leave it out rather than writing it empty. Not used on the Inbox.

mtm-sample.description: Marks the note as sample content, so that "Remove sample content" can find it. Other tools should not set it.
